actual_family.assumption: the genuine canonical Item316 target at n
actual_family.data: unique actual canonical word, nonzero loads Z_j, t, Q^[1], and U_11
actual_family.uniformity: H_n may depend on all actual n-data but is independent of the candidate prime
actual_family.capacity_admission: U_11|H_n with H_n nonzero and log|H_n|=o(log b), or a fixed strict-fraction height, is required for a new bound

carrier_class.coefficient_dependence: arbitrary prime-independent functions of n and actual canonical data subject only to the height envelope

proved.continued_fraction: a/c=[w_m;...;w_1] and every partial quotient is at most A
proved.linear_form_bound: for nonzero (alpha,beta) of height at most B<c, |alpha a+beta c|>=c/((A+2)B)
proved.height_dichotomy: q-dependent carriers have log|H|=(1+o(1))log b; q-free residuals have log|H|=o(log b)
proved.fixed_window_corollary: every fixed q-window with sub-beta coefficient height reduces to the carrier class
proved.bounded_actual_input_corollary: fixed-degree formulas in a bounded number of digits and loads have sub-beta coefficient height
proved.fixed_order_limitation: fixed recurrence order alone is insufficient because an order-one product accumulator has beta-height output

closes: q-dependent p-independent affine-rational carriers with sub-beta reduced coefficients and denominator
bounded fixed q-windows in that class
bounded-order affine recurrences whose unrolled coefficient height is sub-beta
any zero-rate or fixed-fraction capacity claim from those q-dependent carriers
does_not_close: q-free residuals with an actual singleton divisibility implication
nonlinear polynomial, gcd/radical, trace, or quotient formulas outside the class
the actual singleton mass or Route 1

EXACT_FINITE_ONLY: declared continued-fraction, coefficient-box, and fixed-window controls; no prime or target census
OPEN: weighted singleton and growing low-incidence bounds
Xi_Q, squarefull excess, centered half-bound, beta capacity, Route 1, e+pi
